name: project-pulse
description: Your local development adviser: request a Pulse review, read a project's history, and manage its recommendations.
long_description: Project Pulse keeps a review of each development session per project (what you built, benefits, drawbacks, status and up to three next steps) and shows it in its own window. In Claude Desktop, ask Claude for a Pulse review and it will use these tools. Requires Project Pulse to be installed on this PC (Install.cmd).

tools.name: pulse_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects Project Pulse tracks.

tools.name: pulse_project_history
tools.description: Read a project's latest review, open concerns and next steps.

tools.name: pulse_start_review
tools.description: Start a manual Pulse review of the work discussed in this conversation.

tools.name: pulse_submit_review
tools.description: Save the review so it shows in the Project Pulse window.

tools.name: pulse_update_recommendation
tools.description: Plan, dismiss, restore or complete a recommendation when you ask.
